legend: Limak is a little bear who loves to play. Today he is playing by destroying block towers. He built n towers in a row. The i-th tower is made of hi identical blocks. For clarification see picture for the first sample.
Limak will repeat the following operation till everything is destroyed.

Block is called internal if it has all four neighbors, i.e. it has each side (top, left, down and right) adjacent to other block or to the floor. Otherwise, block is boundary. In one operation Limak destroys all boundary blocks. His paws are very fast and he destroys all those blocks at the same time.
Limak is ready to start. You task is to count how many operations will it take him to destroy all towers.
input: The first line contains single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105).
The second line contains n space-separated integers h1, h2, ..., hn (1 ≤ hi ≤ 109) — sizes of towers.
output: Print the number of operations needed to destroy all towers.
note: The picture below shows all three operations for the first sample test. Each time boundary blocks are marked with red color.

legend.ai: Limak 是一只喜欢玩耍的小熊。今天，他要通过摧毁方块塔来玩耍。他在一排中建造了 n 座塔。第 i 座塔由 hi 个相同的方块组成。具体情况请参见第一个样例的图片。
Limak 将重复执行以下操作，直到所有东西都被摧毁。
如果一个方块拥有全部四个相邻方块，即它的每一条边（上、左、下、右）都与其他方块或地面相邻，则称其为内部方块。否则，该方块称为边界方块。在一次操作中，Limak 会摧毁所有边界方块。他的爪子非常快，可以同时摧毁所有这些方块。
Limak 已经准备开始了。你的任务是计算摧毁所有高塔需要进行多少次操作。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 105）。
第二行包含 n 个用空格分隔的整数 h1, h2, ..., hn（1 ≤ hi ≤ 109），表示高塔的大小。

output.ai: 输出摧毁所有高塔所需的操作次数。

note.ai: 下图展示了第一个样例测试中的全部三次操作。每次操作中，边界方块都用红色标记。
